sourceEvidence.note: Dealer source URLs retained from prior research ledger, but published mark was not selected as a suitable image-edit target. Concept is not an official replacement.

generation.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: original dealer-preview logo proposal, transparent PNG.
Primary request: create a completely professional identity for exact name "Eco International Motors".
Concept: custom EIM letter architecture, with a small circular ring around an abstract E segment to imply global mobility—subtle, engineered, not a literal earth, wheel or leaf. Distinct premium fleet trading identity.
Style: elegant modern flat vector, warm humanist geometric wordmark, high clarity at web-header size, carefully proportioned.
Palette: deep charcoal plus dark mineral green (one tasteful color accent); solid inks.
Composition: clean horizontal logo; emblem and "Eco International Motors" exact-text wordmark; truly transparent background and controlled padding.
Constraints: no extra slogan, no electric plug or leaf clichés, no globe or car shape, no shadows, textures, gradients, 3D, watermarks, text errors, or mockups. Proposal only, not dealer adopted.

holdReasons: Genuine source branding not visually compared against concept
Separate compact mark and on-dark/accent variants incomplete
No maintained pack or six-design visual release checks
